aggregation.also_report: equal-weight macro mean across source datasets
aggregation.confidence_interval.method: Nonparametric percentile bootstrap over canonical items, stratified by source_dataset
aggregation.primary_point_estimate: Within each model and family, average eligible available probe scores within canonical item, then average item means. Each canonical item receives equal weight.
aggregation.ranking_policy: No global reliability composite, winner tier, or cross-model significance ranking. Display prompt_group because FLAN-T5 systems did not receive the full system prompt. Report the rule baseline separately as calibration.
analysis_unit: One canonical base input and one canonical probe input rewritten by the same system.
change_control: Any alteration to eligibility, extraction, thresholds, aggregation, or missing-data treatment requires a new contract version. Human validation may validate this version but may not silently alter it.
collateral_proxy.content_f1: Set F1 between the two rewrites' non-focal content-token sets. Empty on either side yields 0.
collateral_proxy.content_token_set: Normalized unique tokens after removing modal tokens, frozen stopwords, one-character tokens, and—only for addition probes—the distractor's content tokens.
collateral_proxy.label_requirement: Always call this an automatic collateral-preservation proxy until validated against item-level human judgments.
collateral_proxy.negation_consistency: Both rewrites contain every negation token shared by the two sources, and the two rewrite negation-token sets are identical.
collateral_proxy.number_consistency: Both rewrites contain every number shared by the two sources, and the two rewrite number sets are identical.
collateral_proxy.primary_pass: content_f1 >= 0.80 AND shared_anchor_recall >= 0.50 AND number_consistency=1 AND negation_consistency=1
collateral_proxy.sensitivity.lenient: content_f1 >= 0.70 AND shared_anchor_recall >= 0.40 with the same exact number and negation constraints
collateral_proxy.sensitivity.strict: content_f1 >= 0.90 AND shared_anchor_recall >= 0.60 with the same exact number and negation constraints
collateral_proxy.shared_anchor_recall: For each rewrite, recall of the intersection of the base and probe sources' content-token sets; take the lower endpoint recall. If the source intersection is empty, define recall as 1.
construct: Whether a controlled source change produces the norm-required focal response while preserving non-focal content in the complete rewrite.
focal_metrics.addition_exact_phrase: The normalized distractor occurs in the probe rewrite and not in the base rewrite.
focal_metrics.addition_uptake_70: Distractor content-token coverage in the probe rewrite is at least 0.70 and strictly greater than coverage in the base rewrite.
focal_metrics.direction_exact_pass: The base rewrite's first modal class equals original_modal's class and the probe rewrite's first modal class equals new_modal's class.
focal_metrics.direction_relation_pass: Both present rewrites have extracted first modal classes and their strict ordering matches weaken or strengthen. Equality fails.
focal_metrics.invariance_exact_pass: Both present rewrites' first modal classes equal the base source's first modal class.
focal_metrics.invariance_relation_pass: Both present rewrites have an extracted first modal class and the two classes are equal.
hidden_failure.eligible_denominator: Source-eligible, technically available pairs for which both endpoint rewrites pass EARS-Struct-v1 at the stated threshold.
hidden_failure.hidden_complete_failure: 1 minus the family primary complete-response pass.
hidden_failure.hidden_focal_failure: 1 minus the family exact focal pass.
modal_scale.missing_extraction: A present nonempty rewrite with no explicit modal receives focal score 0; it is not removed from the denominator.
modal_scale.primary_extractor: First explicit occurrence among shall, must, should, will, may, can in complete-text order.
modal_scale.sensitivity_extractors: unique modal class, undefined when multiple classes occur
ordinary_endpoint_comparator.interpretat: Structural endpoint form only; never call this semantic correctness or full EARS validity.
ordinary_endpoint_comparator.name: EARS-Struct-v1
ordinary_endpoint_comparator.score: 0.3 if 'the' plus one or two words precedes such a modal
0.2 if the trimmed rewrite ends in a period
0.1 if when/if/while/where occurs, otherwise 0.1 if the rewrite starts with 'the' plus a word
prohibited_interpretations: Do not call addition retention harmful copying.
Do not call addition removal shortcut resistance.
Do not average invariance, directional, and addition metrics into global reliability.
Do not retain the old balanced-tier claim.
Do not use the SRS-simplification comparison as a controlled norm-shift effect.
Do not call the collateral proxy validated semantic preservation without item-level human evidence.
Do not treat EARS-Struct-v1 as endpoint correctness.
source_eligibility.addition.include_if: distractor text has at least one content token
the normalized probe source contains the distractor
the normalized base source does not contain the distractor
source_eligibility.addition.interpretati: Descriptive addition uptake only. It is not correctness, shortcut resistance, or harmful-copying evidence.
source_eligibility.directional.expected_: The first modal class in the rewritten probe must move in the declared direction; exact focal response additionally requires both rewritten endpoints to match their source modal classes.
source_eligibility.directional.include_i: original_modal and new_modal are both in the frozen scale
their classes differ and agree with the declared direction
the first explicit modal in the base source is original_modal
the first explicit modal in the probe source is new_modal
source_eligibility.general: Eligibility is determined only from frozen source/probe metadata and source text, never from a model output.
source_eligibility.invariance.expected_r: Both rewritten endpoints should express the base source's first modal class.
source_eligibility.invariance.include_if: the base source contains at least one explicit modal from the frozen scale
technical_availability.known_missingness: Qwen2.5-32B has one missing base output and its three probe outputs for one repaired duplicate-ID item; this creates three technically unavailable pairs.
technical_availability.missing_cache_rec: Technical missingness: exclude from metric denominators, report coverage, and never impute.
technical_availability.pair_available_if: Both canonical output records have output_present=1.
Both rewrites are nonempty after trimming.
technical_availability.present_but_unpar: Scored failure for the affected focal component.
